title: Late French Korean War veteran to be buried at U.N. cemetery in Busan
caption:
A French veteran of the Korean War, Serge Archambeau, is being laid to rest at the U.N. Memorial Cemetery in Busan. He fought on T-Bone Hill in 1952 and requested to be buried in South Korea.

Source: En - Late French Korean War veteran to be buried at U.N. cemetery in Busan
